observations.observation: The first UNIT-005 control-plane inspection found that contracts/milestone-0032.json still directed the audit to canonical-container commit f61caf6582e4095f9075f2ccc9a4de9f4f5c5f53 and said review had not opened, even though public reconciliation commit a0fbde12ad4d562239320f72dceea6a1337d99d7 was already exact and draft PR #30 had been opened from that head.
observations.containment: No audit pass, review readiness, merge, tag, release, deployment, image publication, or real-infrastructure action was inferred from stale text. Draft PR #30 remained draft while the living records were reconciled.
observations.correction: Update only active truth records to name public reconciliation a0fbde12ad4d562239320f72dceea6a1337d99d7, draft PR #30, and the latest public branch head as the audit input; then publish and independently verify the bounded correction before evaluating the premerge audit.

observations.observation: A post-correction validation wrapper invoked scripts/verify_container_contract.py with obsolete --root and --result options. Argparse rejected the command before reading the frozen contract or canonical receipt.
observations.containment: No container result, audit pass, repository byte, image, review state, or release state changed, and the rejected invocation supplied no positive evidence.
observations.correction: Use the repository-owned --contract and --receipt options with --require-implementation and --require-result, then require the unchanged validator to pass.

observations.observation: The same wrapper invoked scripts/verify_package_contract.py with an unsupported --root option. Argparse rejected the command before reading the frozen contract or selected archive.
observations.containment: No package, audit pass, repository byte, review state, or release state changed, and the rejected invocation supplied no positive evidence.
observations.correction: Use the repository-owned --contract, --archive, and --source-root options, then require the unchanged validator to pass.

observations.observation: The first accepted package-validator invocation passed src as --source-root even though the frozen contract records repository-relative src and eval paths. The unchanged validator therefore reported every recorded source path missing and returned status fail.
observations.containment: The failure changed no archive, contract, source, audit, review, image, or release state; it was not used as evidence about package validity.
observations.correction: Pass the repository root as --source-root so every frozen repository-relative path resolves exactly, then require status pass with the same contract and archive bytes.
